args.title: Halvorsen Supply newsletter summary — Freight pricing this quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter: Halvorsen Supply's latest newsletter highlights "Freight pricing this quarter" and links to the full article on their blog.
- Article: Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece: Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
